sentences.en: So, we're seeing sharp declines in new cases.
sentences.zh: 我们看到新增病例急剧下降。

sentences.zh: 从1月初每天26万例下降到现在的约17万例，降幅约为33%。

sentences.zh: 我们看到住院人数下降了约10%。

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.en: Well, we've seen this before in that we've seen cases rise and then drop.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们以前也见过这种情况，即病例上升然后下降。

sentences.zh: 我们在感恩节期间就看到了这一点。

sentences.en: We saw it right over Christmas.
sentences.zh: 我们在圣诞节期间也看到了。

sentences.en: And now we're seeing it where it rose until January 9th and then began to drop.
sentences.zh: 现在我们看到它在1月9日之前一直在上升，然后开始下降。

sentences.en: Now, those might have been false starts in a way in that Thanksgiving, a lot more people got tested in order to get on airplanes for Thanksgiving travel.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些在某种程度上可能是假象，因为在感恩节，为了搭乘飞机出行，有更多人接受了检测。

sentences.en: And of course, you pick up some cases that way.
sentences.zh: 当然，你也会通过这种方式发现一些病例。

sentences.en: Then you saw the same thing at Christmas, Christmas travel again.
sentences.zh: 然后你在圣诞节也看到了同样的情况，又是圣诞出行。

sentences.en: Then on January 9th, it started going down.
sentences.zh: 接着在1月9日，病例开始下降。

sentences.en: And, you know, January, February is not a time when Americans go on holiday travel very much.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，一月和二月并不是美国人进行假日旅行的高峰期。

sentences.en: And so, this might be the real thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，这可能是真实的情况。

sentences.en: You've got a fairly steady level of testing, but the number of positive cases in that steady level of testing begins to go down and is now going down pretty substantially.
sentences.zh: 检测水平相当稳定，但在稳定的检测水平下，阳性病例数开始下降，而且现在下降得相当明显。

sentences.en: And when you say the real thing, Donald, that's a very tantalizing concept.
sentences.zh: 当你提到“真实情况”时，唐纳德，这是一个非常诱人的概念。

sentences.en: Does that mean that finally we've turned a corner in the pandemic?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着我们终于在疫情中迎来了转机？

sentences.en: What do you mean when you say the real thing?
sentences.zh: 当你提到“真实情况”时，你指的是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, it's not an artifact of testing for holiday travel and then a lag.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这并非假日旅行检测带来的假象及其后续效应。

sentences.en: There really are fewer cases each day in the United States.
sentences.zh: 美国每天的病例确实在减少。

sentences.en: And we see that state to state to state.
sentences.zh: 我们从各个州的情况都能看到这一点。

sentences.zh: 实际上，除了

sentences.en: So, this looks like we really are seeing a turning point in the trajectory of the virus that the number of cases has gone up to a peak and look like it's coming down.
sentences.zh: 所以，这看起来我们确实看到了病毒轨迹的转折点，病例数在达到峰值后似乎正在下降。

sentences.en: We've reached the point now where about a third of the country has been infected.
sentences.zh: 我们现在已经达到这样一个阶段：全国约有三分之一的人口被感染。

sentences.en: If you look at the total number of cases, 25 million cases, basically most epidemiological models now multiply that by about
sentences.zh: 如果你看病例总数，2500万例，基本上大多数流行病学模型现在都会将其乘以约

sentences.en: four to get the number of real infections we have in the country.

sentences.en: So, roughly, we're between 100 million cases and 110 million cases, actual infections, including the asymptomatic ones, which means that

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And when you reach the point in any herd, in any population, where about a third of it is infected, the virus doesn't stop, but the virus begins to slow down.
sentences.zh: 当你在任何群体、任何人口中达到约三分之一被感染的程度时，病毒并不会停止，但传播速度会开始减慢。

sentences.en: Because in any herd, whether it's a bunch of horses in a corral or it's a bunch of people in a bar, about a third of them are immune to the virus.
sentences.zh: 因为在任何群体中，无论是围栏里的一群马，还是酒吧里的一群人，其中约三分之一的人对病毒具有免疫力。

sentences.en: So, the virus can't just ricochet through that crowd as fast as it did months ago when everybody was susceptible to it.
sentences.zh: 所以，病毒无法像几个月前每个人都易感时那样，在人群中迅速传播。

sentences.en: So, behind this good news decline in the pandemic is the kind of awful reality that the coronavirus has run wild
sentences.zh: 所以，疫情好转下降的背后，是一种可怕的现实，即冠状病毒在美国肆虐，

sentences.en: through the United States and infected a third of our population and rendered a third of our population essentially immune.
sentences.zh: 感染了我们三分之一的人口，并使三分之一的人口基本上获得了免疫力。

sentences.en: And some of them dead.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人已经死亡。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: When people were talking months ago about reaching herd immunity, that was the argument.

sentences.en: Do we hide people away to protect them, or do we reach herd immunity by letting the virus wash through us?

sentences.en: Just let her rip.

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Meaning one and a half times as likely to infect somebody because it's got a mutation on the spike protein and in the receptor binding domain of the spike
sentences.zh: 这意味着感染某人的可能性是原来的1.5倍，因为它在刺突蛋白上以及刺突蛋白的受体结合域发生了突变，

sentences.en: But really it's not.

sentences.en: And when antibodies attack, they kind of work their way through this tangle of telephone wire and glom onto bits of the protein.

sentences.en: And if you change the shape of the protein, some of the antibodies may not be able to make their way through this jumble of telephone wire and attach where they normally

sentences.en: Doesn't mean your response is totally wiped out.

sentences.en: It's as if you had, you know, no armor and now you've got armor with a bunch of holes in it.
sentences.zh: 这就好比你本来没有盔甲，现在你有了盔甲，但上面有很多洞。

sentences.en: Well, some arrows can get in and some arrows can't.

sentences.en: You can still be killed, but it may be harder.

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: to where they're supposed to go to damage that spike and make it harder for the virus to infect us.

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.en: the protein folds, which changes the ultimate shape of the protein once it's all balled up.

sentences.en: day saying that the British variant might be a third more lethal, but that's based on very preliminary evidence.

sentences.zh: 这正是科学家们所担心的。

sentences.en: It is inevitable.
sentences.zh: 他们担心如果我们不能足够快地为人们接种疫苗，英国变异株就会传播并成为主要变异株。

sentences.en: It is what scientists are afraid of.
sentences.zh: 美国疾控中心已经预测到3月份就会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: They are afraid that if we don't vaccinate people fast enough, that the British variant will spread and become the dominant variant.
sentences.zh: 这意味着新增感染将会加速。

sentences.en: The CDC has already predicted that that will happen by March.
sentences.zh: 现在这变成了一场疫苗接种与变异株传播之间的竞赛。

sentences.en: And that means new infections will speed up.
sentences.zh: 人们担心的是，如果变异株的传播速度快于疫苗接种速度，你就会看到病例再次开始上升，走向另一个高峰。

sentences.en: And it's now becoming a race between vaccinating people and the spread of the variant.
sentences.zh: 现在这已经演变成了一场疫苗接种与变异病毒传播之间的赛跑。

sentences.en: And the fear is that if the variant spreads faster than the vaccine can, you'll see cases begin to go up again towards another peak.
sentences.zh: 人们担心的是，如果变异病毒的传播速度超过了疫苗接种的速度，病例数可能会再次攀升，迎来新一波高峰。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 这一个月你可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能读到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Donald, before the break, you were describing the threat that these coronavirus variants pose to
sentences.zh: 那么唐纳德，在休息之前，你一直在描述这些新冠病毒变种带来的威胁，以及

sentences.en: the decline in new infections and the threat that they pose to the vaccines we have developed for an earlier version of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 它们对新增感染人数下降趋势的威胁，以及对我们针对早期新冠病毒版本研发的疫苗所构成的威胁。

sentences.en: Just how much less effective do we expect a Pfizer or a Moderna vaccine to be against the Brazilian or the South African variants?
sentences.zh: 我们预计辉瑞或莫德纳疫苗对巴西或南非变种的有效性会降低多少？

sentences.en: I don't think we know yet just exactly how less effective.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们还不知道具体会降低多少。

sentences.en: There was a scientist yesterday who said, look, these vaccines induce a super awesome amount of antibodies in you, and now they are reduced to
sentences.zh: 昨天有位科学家说，你看，这些疫苗能在你体内诱导出超级惊人的抗体水平，而现在它们被削弱到了

sentences.en: merely an awesome level of antibodies.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是惊人的水平。

sentences.en: So we still think these vaccines will probably work.
sentences.zh: 所以我们仍然认为这些疫苗很可能会有效。

sentences.en: And remember, it's not just antibodies that the vaccines inspire to work in your body.
sentences.zh: 记住，疫苗在体内激发的作用不仅仅是抗体。

sentences.en: They also trigger the B cells and the T cells, which are part of the immune system.
sentences.zh: 它们还会触发B细胞和T细胞，这些都是免疫系统的一部分。

sentences.en: And there are other things, macrophages that come in and gobble up viruses, all sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 还有其他东西，比如巨噬细胞，它们会进来吞噬病毒，各种各样的东西。

sentences.en: There's a complex response in your immune system.
sentences.zh: 你的免疫系统有复杂的反应。

sentences.en: But the easiest thing to measure is antibodies, so that's what we look at.
sentences.zh: 但最容易测量的是抗体，所以我们看的就是这个。

sentences.en: Scientists assume, based on what they know, that the vaccines will still be pretty good.
sentences.zh: 科学家根据已知情况推测，这些疫苗应该仍然相当有效。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, as we do with flu every year, they are tweaking the vaccine vaccine to make it a little more perfectly targeted.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，就像我们每年应对流感一样，他们正在微调疫苗，使其目标更精准。

sentences.en: Pfizer and Moderna have announced that they can do that, to come up with sort of a booster shot that could be added to the two shots you get of each of those vaccines.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞和莫德纳已经宣布他们可以做到这一点，即研发出一种加强针，可以加在你已经接种的那两剂疫苗之上。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That would mean a third shot for a person who was vaccinated, and it would be specially reformulated to address one of these variants or multiple variants?
sentences.zh: 那意味着对于已经接种过的人来说，需要打第三针，而且它是专门重新配制的，以应对其中一种或多种变种？

sentences.en: Well, yeah, that's what it would mean.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，就是这个意思。

sentences.en: But that's in a perfect world where everybody's had their two shots already.
sentences.zh: 但这只是在每个人都已经打完两针的理想世界里。

sentences.en: You'd have the third one.
sentences.zh: 你才会打第三针。

sentences.en: We haven't, we're not close to the perfect world yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有，我们离那个理想世界还很远。

sentences.en: So it's good that they're doing that work, but it's also going to take some weeks to actually make that vaccine.
sentences.zh: 所以他们做这项工作很好，但真正制造出那种疫苗还需要几周时间。

sentences.en: Then they have to brew it up and distribute it.
sentences.zh: 然后他们还得生产出来并分发出去。

sentences.en: So the foot race that's going on right now between the vaccines and the variants is going to be played out well before that third booster shot comes along.
sentences.zh: 所以目前疫苗和变种之间的这场赛跑，在第三针加强针出现之前就已经分出胜负了。

sentences.en: The battle is on right now.
sentences.zh: 战斗现在就已经开始了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So in this foot race between the variant and the vaccine, how do we stop the spread of the variants?
sentences.zh: 那么在变种和疫苗的这场赛跑中，我们如何阻止变种的传播？

sentences.en: The United States has not been very good at stopping the spread of any variations of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 美国在阻止任何新冠病毒变种传播方面做得并不好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's too late to stop the spread of the
sentences.zh: 现在阻止

sentences.en: British variant.
sentences.zh: 英国变种的传播已经太晚了。

sentences.en: It's in multiple states, more than 20.
sentences.zh: 它已经在多个州出现了，超过20个州。

sentences.en: It's imperative to stop the spread of the
sentences.zh: 当务之急是阻止

sentences.en: South African and Brazilian variants.
sentences.zh: 南非和巴西变种的传播。

sentences.en: And the way you do that is to block travel from those countries.
sentences.zh: 而阻止的方法就是封锁来自这些国家的旅行。

sentences.en: And the Biden administration has picked up and strengthened some of the stuff that the Trump administration was doing.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府已经接手并加强了特朗普政府所做的一些工作。

sentences.en: There is a, is or will be soon a ban on travel from Britain or South Africa or Brazil, but they're also making an incorrect assumption that the Trump administration did
sentences.zh: 目前有，或者很快就会有针对来自英国、南非或巴西的旅行禁令，但他们也做出了一个特朗普政府曾反复犯下的错误假设，即

sentences.en: repeatedly, which is that only banning citizens of those countries will stop the virus.
sentences.zh: 仅仅禁止这些国家的公民入境就能阻止病毒。

sentences.en: When in fact, the virus is, doesn't care what passport you carry and is perfectly happy to come here in an American nose as, as, as in a foreign nose, if you like.
sentences.zh: 而事实上，病毒并不在乎你持什么护照，它完全乐意通过美国人的鼻子进入这里，就像通过外国人的鼻子一样，如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: And so you have to do something also to stop the
sentences.zh: 所以你还必须采取措施来阻止

sentences.en: Americans from carrying that virus into the country.
sentences.zh: 美国人将病毒带入国内。

sentences.en: And, you know, the answer that many countries would have, everybody from China to Singapore to New Zealand would be quarantine those people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，许多国家的做法，从中国到新加坡再到新西兰，都会对这些人进行隔离。

sentences.en: Maybe not for 14 whole days, but, you know, long enough to, to give them maybe a couple of different kinds of tests to make sure they're actually negative.
sentences.zh: 也许不需要整整14天，但你知道，足够长的时间来给他们做几次不同类型的检测，以确保他们确实是阴性。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is right now we're letting Americans travel from Brazil and South Africa back to the United States, potentially carrying the virus with them.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，现在我们允许美国人从巴西和南非回到美国，他们可能随身携带了病毒。

sentences.en: And we're not carefully monitoring their quarantine the way countries like China have.
sentences.zh: 而且我们并没有像中国等国家那样仔细监控他们的隔离情况。

sentences.en: In other words, these travel bans are very porous and in a sense, kind of useless.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这些旅行禁令漏洞百出，在某种意义上是毫无用处的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this has happened before.
sentences.zh: 这种情况以前也发生过。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, in, in 2009, when the H1N1 swine flu from
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，在2009年，当来自墨西哥的H1N1猪流感

sentences.en: Mexico was a threat, there were some cases in Southern California and Texas where everybody
sentences.zh: 构成威胁时，南加州和德克萨斯州出现了一些病例，每个人都

sentences.en: thought, oh, it's coming over the border, but it landed in New York city in 27 students from
sentences.zh: 以为，哦，它是从边境过来的，但它实际上是在纽约市登陆的，源于皇后区圣弗朗西斯高中的27名学生，

sentences.en: St. Francis high school in Queens who had all gone to Cancun on their spring break.
sentences.zh: 他们都在春假期间去了坎昆。

sentences.en: And that's how the disease came to New York city.
sentences.zh: 这就是疾病来到纽约市的方式。

sentences.en: So, I mean, it's common.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，这很常见。

sentences.en: It's just as common for a disease to come back in returning Americans as it is in foreigners.
sentences.zh: 疾病通过回国的美国人传播，和通过外国人传播一样常见。

sentences.en: So we should assume that the South African and
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该假设南非和

sentences.en: Brazilian variants will be with us if, if they already aren't with us, we should assume that if we're not careful, they will definitely be here and begin to spread.
sentences.zh: 巴西变种将与我们共存，如果它们还没有出现的话，我们应该假设如果我们不小心，它们肯定会来到这里并开始传播。

sentences.en: There's still time to contain this.
sentences.zh: 现在还有时间控制住它。

sentences.en: We think, but we have to move fast and we have to move aggressively.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，但我们必须行动迅速，必须采取积极的行动。

sentences.en: I just want to say for the record, this conversation started with good news.
sentences.zh: 我只想郑重声明，这次谈话是以好消息开始的。

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We're always caught in this bind, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 我们总是陷入这种困境，不是吗？

sentences.en: So you started to hint at what president Biden is up to.
sentences.zh: 所以你开始暗示拜登总统正在做什么了。

sentences.en: And now that you have laid out the pretty challenging landscape that he is inheriting when it comes to the pandemic, help me understand what his approach is so far.
sentences.zh: 既然你已经列出了他在疫情方面所继承的相当严峻的局面，请帮我理解他目前的应对方法。

sentences.en: I know it's just been a few days and how much it's differing from the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 我知道才过去几天，而且它与特朗普政府有多大不同。

sentences.en: Well, he's got scientists in charge of the response whom he is allowing to speak, or he has, he has said that it will be that way that Tony Fauci will
sentences.zh: 嗯，他让科学家负责应对工作，并允许他们发言，或者他已经说过会是这样，托尼·福奇现在

sentences.en: now be allowed to say what's going on rather than having the president say what's going on.
sentences.zh: 将被允许说明情况，而不是由总统来说明情况。

sentences.en: And then
sentences.zh: 然后

sentences.en: Tony Fauci being forced to contradict him and being caught in an awkward bind.
sentences.zh: 托尼·福奇被迫反驳他，陷入尴尬的境地。

sentences.en: You have Rochelle
sentences.zh: 你有罗谢尔·

sentences.en: Walensky, who's an expert on infectious diseases running the CDC.
sentences.zh: 瓦伦斯基，一位传染病专家在管理疾控中心。

sentences.en: And rather than being silent, she says there will be regular briefings from her or from her experts.
sentences.zh: 她没有保持沉默，而是表示她或她的专家会定期举行简报会。

sentences.en: You know, all these are incredibly good signs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些都是非常好的迹象。

sentences.en: This is the way we used to be here.
sentences.zh: 这才是我们过去的样子。

sentences.en: I mean, during previous epidemics, you know, the president would occasionally say things, but mostly the head of the CDC,
sentences.zh: 我是说，在之前的流行病期间，你知道，总统偶尔会说些话，但主要是疾控中心负责人，

sentences.en: sometimes the surgeon general, sometimes Tony Fauci would, you know, get up there and tell the truth about what was happening.
sentences.zh: 有时是卫生局局长，有时是托尼·福奇，你知道，会站出来说出正在发生的真相。

sentences.en: You know, in the past there would be, you know, a television appearance by somebody, you know, maybe once every couple of weeks, but there would be three or four telephone
sentences.zh: 你知道，过去会有，你知道，某人出现在电视上，你知道，也许每几周一次，但每周会有三到四次电话

sentences.en: briefings a week for reporters with a lot of time to ask questions and, you know, a lot of experts being encouraged, you know, Dan, why don't you take that one?
sentences.zh: 简报会，让记者有充足的时间提问，而且，你知道，很多专家被鼓励，你知道，丹，为什么你不回答那个问题？

sentences.en: Because that's your area of expertise.
sentences.zh: 因为那是你的专业领域。

sentences.en: You know, the person to be in charge of vaccination would be there on the phone call.
sentences.zh: 你知道，负责疫苗接种的人会在电话会议上。

sentences.en: Whoever, you know, you listen to the experts and that's what I hope is going to happen this time.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，你知道，你听取专家的意见，这就是我希望这次会发生的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, we'll have a science-based response, you know, which we did not have before.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们将会有基于科学的应对，你知道，这是我们之前没有的。

sentences.en: We had a panic-based response and a let's not scare the stock market-based response that it's all going to go away response and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们之前有过基于恐慌的应对，有过基于“别吓坏股市”的应对，有过“一切都会过去”的应对等等。

sentences.en: So we hopefully this will be taken seriously.
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望这次能认真对待。

sentences.en: Well, handing press conferences to scientists is one thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，把新闻发布会交给科学家是一回事。

sentences.en: I think the thing most Americans want to get a handle on is how much more efficiently will vaccines be distributed and administered under this new presidency?
sentences.zh: 我认为大多数美国人最想了解的是，在这个新总统任期下，疫苗的分发和接种效率会提高多少？

sentences.en: That feels like where the rubber's going to meet the road.
sentences.zh: 这感觉才是真正的考验所在。

sentences.en: And so far, President Biden has articulated a set of goals not all that different in ambition from the Trump administration in terms of about a million
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，拜登总统阐述的一系列目标，在雄心壮志上与特朗普政府并没有太大不同，大约是每天一百万

sentences.en: vaccinations a day.
sentences.zh: 次疫苗接种。

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: Well, we have reached about one million doses in arms per day, and they now hope to ramp that up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们已经达到了每天约一百万剂的接种量，他们现在希望提高这个数字。

sentences.en: Maybe we can reach one and a half million a day pretty soon.
sentences.zh: 也许我们很快就能达到每天一百五十万次。

sentences.en: That means assuring and keeping track of a steady supply of vaccines coming out of the factories and getting to the states.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要确保并跟踪从工厂出来的疫苗的稳定供应，并将其运送到各州。

sentences.en: The states and cities will still be in charge of just sticking the vaccines into the arms, but you can help them do that a lot.
sentences.zh: 各州和城市仍将负责将疫苗接种到人们手臂上，但你可以给他们很多帮助。

sentences.en: You can give them money to train vaccinators and set up vaccination centers.
sentences.zh: 你可以给他们钱来培训接种人员并建立疫苗接种中心。

sentences.en: You can optimize the supply to those places and set up a database where everything can be reported so that we have a very clear idea at the end of each day how many
sentences.zh: 你可以优化这些地方的供应，并建立一个数据库，让所有信息都能上报，这样我们在每天结束时就能非常清楚地知道有多少

sentences.en: vaccines are on hand and where they are.
sentences.zh: 疫苗在手，以及它们在哪里。

sentences.en: In other words, this can be more centralized.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这可以更加集中化。

sentences.en: The Biden administration can do that.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, given these variants and their spread, given the pretty messy situation with vaccine administration so far, how optimistic are you that the timelines that have been
sentences.zh: 那么，考虑到这些变种及其传播，考虑到目前疫苗接种方面相当混乱的情况，你对这个国家人们心中已经相当坚定地植入的关于何时恢复正常的时间表有多乐观，它们真的可行吗？

sentences.en: pretty firmly planted in people's heads in this country about when normalcy will return are actually plausible?
sentences.zh: 我们过去在节目中提到过它们。

sentences.en: We have mentioned them on the show in the paSt. The notion was that by the end of the
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是到夏天结束时，情况可能会看起来和过去很像，但我开始对那个时间表产生怀疑了。

sentences.en: summer, things might look a lot like they used to look, and I'm starting to have my doubts about that timeline.
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: How about you?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我并不完全认同“夏天结束时”这个说法。

sentences.en: Well, I don't subscribe to by the end of the summer exactly.
sentences.zh: 我一直试图抵制预测未来。

sentences.en: I have tried to resist predicting the future all along.
sentences.zh: 我最终还是乐观地认为，今年某个时候情况会恢复正常，但我说不出具体是什么时候。

sentences.en: I'm ultimately optimistic that sometime this year things will be back to normal, but I can't say when.
sentences.zh: 每次我这么说的时候，我总是说，你知道，如果事情完全按预期进行，如果多种疫苗获得批准，如果生产过程中没有出现任何问题，

sentences.en: And every time I said that, I always said, you know, if things roll out exactly as hoped, if multiple vaccines are approved, if nothing goes wrong
sentences.zh: 如果，你知道，假设人们比我们去年想象的更愿意接受疫苗，它会在某个时候发生。

sentences.en: in the production process, if, you know, assuming people are going to accept the vaccines more than we thought last year, it's going to happen sometime.
sentences.zh: 但我不想说，你知道，6月15日什么的。

sentences.en: But I don't want to say, you know, June 15th or whatever.
sentences.zh: 这还不确定。

sentences.en: It's up in the air.
sentences.zh: 如果我们加快速度，它会到来，疫苗接种，它会来得更早。

sentences.en: If we speed up, it'll come, the vaccination, it'll come sooner.
sentences.zh: 如果病毒发生根本性变化，我们会有新的问题。而且，就像我说的，这将是一场战斗。

sentences.en: If the virus changes radically, we'll have new probleMs. And it's, like I said, it's going to be a battle.
sentences.zh: 加快疫苗接种。

sentences.en: Speed up the vaccination.
sentences.zh: 试图阻止变种，那些糟糕的变种在这个国家传播。

sentences.en: Try to stop the variants, the bad variants from spreading in this country.
sentences.zh: 尽我们所能去赛跑，超过已经在国内的英国变种。

sentences.en: Do as much as we can to outrace the British variant, which is already in the country.
sentences.zh: 并希望没有新的、真正危险的美国变种出现。

sentences.en: And hope that no new, truly dangerous American variants spring up.
sentences.zh: 这种可能性也总是存在的。

sentences.en: There's always that possibility, too.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须问，你接种疫苗了吗？

sentences.en: So I have to ask, have you gotten your vaccine?
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 我正在努力。

sentences.en: And I'm trying.
sentences.zh: 我一开始没有像我应该做的那样努力。

sentences.en: I didn't try as hard in the beginning as I should have.
sentences.zh: 我算是错过了机会。

sentences.en: And I sort of missed the boat.
sentences.zh: 我多次拨打了一些热线电话。

sentences.en: I have called some of the hotlines multiple times.
sentences.zh: 我甚至接到过回电。

sentences.en: I've even had a call back.
sentences.zh: 但在提供了所有信息后，我被告知，哦，对不起，没有预约了。

sentences.en: And after giving all the information, I was told, oh, I'm sorry, there's no more appointments.
sentences.zh: 我说，认真的吗，我又回到原点了吗？

sentences.en: And I'm like, seriously, am I back to square one?
sentences.zh: 对不起，先生。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, sir.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想见我的孙女。

sentences.en: You know, I'd like to see my granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 我想接种疫苗。

sentences.en: I'd like to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 现在，我的群体目前有37.5%的免疫力。

sentences.en: Now, my herd is currently 37.5% immune.
sentences.zh: 我可以解释我是怎么达到这个数字的。

sentences.en: And I can explain how I got there.
sentences.zh: 我和我的女朋友在一起。

sentences.en: So I'm with my girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 她在一家医院兼职做志愿者，有时会看病人。

sentences.en: She works, volunteers part-time at a hospital, sometimes seeing patients.
sentences.zh: 所以她接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: So she got vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 一个人接种了。

sentences.en: One does.
sentences.zh: 我们和一对夫妇待在我们的社交圈里。

sentences.en: We hang out in our pod with a couple.
sentences.zh: 我们和一对夫妇待在我们的社交圈里。

sentences.en: We'll call them Fred and
sentences.zh: 我们叫他们弗雷德和

sentences.en: Ethel.
sentences.zh: 埃塞尔。

sentences.en: Fred is having cancer treatment.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德正在接受癌症治疗。

sentences.en: And so his oncologist got him a job.
sentences.zh: 所以他的肿瘤科医生帮他找了份工作。

sentences.en: And Ethel was able to get through the hotline of the Javits Center.
sentences.zh: 埃塞尔成功打通了贾维茨中心的预约热线。

sentences.en: So they've all had one of two shots.
sentences.zh: 所以他们都接种了两针疫苗中的一针。

sentences.en: So that's 75% of our pod is half vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 也就是说我们这个小圈子里有75%的人接种了一半疫苗。

sentences.en: So that's 37.5% protection.
sentences.zh: 所以保护率是37.5%。

sentences.en: I'm the zero inside the herd.
sentences.zh: 我是群体免疫里的那个零。

sentences.en: I'm the goat in the buffalo herd, if you like.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，我就是水牛群里的那只山羊。

sentences.en: But, you know, I'm getting closer.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道，我离目标越来越近了。

sentences.en: And, you know, once I can find the vaccine and I get two and I wait a couple of weeks till the antibodies kick in, then I'll be able to see my granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，一旦我能找到疫苗，接种两针，再等上几周让抗体起作用，我就能见到我的孙女了。

sentences.en: But for now, you're the skunk at the picnic.
sentences.zh: 但目前，你就是野餐会上的那只臭鼬。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Skunk at the picnic, the goat in the buffalo herd, whatever.
sentences.zh: 野餐会上的臭鼬，水牛群里的山羊，随你怎么说。

sentences.en: Well, I wish you, I wish you the best of luck as you work the phones and navigate pretty tricky system.
sentences.zh: 好吧，祝你好运，希望你能顺利打通电话，搞定这个相当棘手的系统。

sentences.en: Well, thanks.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: I'll let you know how it goes.
sentences.zh: 我会告诉你进展如何。

sentences.en: Please do.
sentences.zh: 请务必告知。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Donald.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你，唐纳德。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Take care of Michael.
sentences.zh: 照顾好迈克尔。

sentences.en: The first confirmed U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国首例确诊的

sentences.en: case of the Brazilian variant has been detected in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 巴西变异毒株病例已在明尼苏达州被发现。

sentences.en: Local health officials said that the case involved a U.S.
sentences.zh: 当地卫生官员表示，该病例涉及一名美国

sentences.en: resident who had recently traveled to Brazil, the kind of traveler whose movements would not be impacted by current U.S.
sentences.zh: 居民，他最近曾前往巴西，这类旅行者的行程不会受到当前美国

sentences.en: travel rules.
sentences.zh: 旅行规则的影响。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the acting chief of the
sentences.zh: 周二，国会警察局代理局长

sentences.en: Capitol Police apologized to Congress for failing to secure the Capitol on January 6th when pro-Trump rioters stormed the building.
sentences.zh: 就1月6日未能保护国会大厦免受特朗普支持者的冲击向国会道歉。

sentences.en: In closed-door testimony before the House, the chief, Yogananda
sentences.zh: 在众议院的闭门听证会上，局长尤加南达·

sentences.en: Pittman, said that the Capitol Police understood that there was, quote, strong potential for violence, but had failed to take the necessary steps to prepare for it.
sentences.zh: 皮特曼表示，国会警察局明白当时存在“强烈的暴力可能性”，但未能采取必要的准备措施。

sentences.en: And a majority of Senate Republicans voted against holding an impeachment trial of former President Trump, suggesting that the Senate does not have enough votes to convict him.
sentences.zh: 此外，大多数参议院共和党人投票反对对前总统特朗普进行弹劾审判，这表明参议院没有足够的票数来判定他有罪。

sentences.en: Just five Republicans joined 50 Democrats in voting to move ahead with the trial.
sentences.zh: 只有五名共和党人与50名民主党人一起投票支持继续进行审判。

sentences.en: Seventeen Republicans would need to cross party lines in order to convict Trump during next month's trial.
sentences.zh: 在下个月的审判中，需要17名共和党人跨越党派界限才能给特朗普定罪。
